name: dev
description: Code state while agents work: git branch, session diff, test pulse, coverage delta, typecheck feedback, PR radar and port watch

mod_git_enabled.title: Git chip enabled
mod_git_enabled.description: Turn the Git chip mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

mod_diff_enabled.title: Session Diff enabled
mod_diff_enabled.description: Turn the Session Diff mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

mod_pulse_enabled.title: Test Pulse enabled
mod_pulse_enabled.description: Turn the Test Pulse mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

mod_coverage_enabled.title: Coverage Delta enabled
mod_coverage_enabled.description: Turn the Coverage Delta mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

mod_typecheck_enabled.title: Typecheck Feedback enabled
mod_typecheck_enabled.description: Turn the Typecheck Feedback mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

mod_pr_enabled.title: PR Radar enabled
mod_pr_enabled.description: Turn the PR Radar mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

mod_ports_enabled.title: Port Watch enabled
mod_ports_enabled.description: Turn the Port Watch mod on or off. Off registers no hooks and draws nothing.

minBandRows.title: Minimum band rows
minBandRows.description: The band stays silent when the screen has fewer free rows than this.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Background polling (gh, lsof) pauses when there was no user input for this long.

git_minRefreshSec.title: Git min refresh (s)
git_minRefreshSec.description: Minimum seconds between git status refreshes.

git_untracked.title: Git untracked files
git_untracked.description: normal counts untracked files; no skips them (huge repos).

git_showWorktree.title: Show worktree name
git_showWorktree.description: Append the linked worktree name to the git chip.

changes_maxRows.title: Session Diff max rows
changes_maxRows.description: Rows shown in the changes pane before '+N more'.

changes_openCommand.title: Open command
changes_openCommand.description: Command run by /changes open <n>; {path} is the absolute file path.

pr_intervalSec.title: PR poll interval (s)
pr_intervalSec.description: Base seconds between gh calls (never below 60).

pr_maxPrs.title: PR limit
pr_maxPrs.description: Maximum pull requests listed per gh call.

pr_toastOnFail.title: Toast on failing checks
pr_toastOnFail.description: Raise one toast when checks on your own open PR flip to failing.

pulse_includeSubagents.title: Test Pulse: include subagents
pulse_includeSubagents.description: Count test runs made by subagents.

pulse_flaky.title: Test Pulse: flaky detection
pulse_flaky.description: Track tests that fail and then pass with no edits between.

pulse_maxNames.title: Test Pulse: max names
pulse_maxNames.description: Maximum failing test names kept per run.

coverage_baseline.title: Coverage baseline
coverage_baseline.description: session-first: first reading this session; last-clean: stored reading from a clean tree.

coverage_warnDropPts.title: Coverage drop warning (pts)
coverage_warnDropPts.description: A drop beyond this many percentage points uses the warning look.

tc_mode.title: Typecheck mode
tc_mode.description: context: feed errors back to Claude; band: chip only; off.

tc_tsc.title: Typecheck: tsc
tc_tsc.description: Run incremental tsc on edited TypeScript files.

tc_ruff.title: Typecheck: ruff
tc_ruff.description: Run ruff on edited Python files.

tc_eslint.title: Typecheck: eslint
tc_eslint.description: Run eslint on edited JS/TS files when the project has a config.

tc_timeoutSec.title: tsc budget (s)
tc_timeoutSec.description: Seconds the edit result waits for tsc before returning unchanged.

tc_maxLines.title: Feedback max lines
tc_maxLines.description: Maximum error lines appended to a tool result.

ports_enabled.title: Port Watch enabled
ports_enabled.description: Watch listening ports started by agents.

ports_stale_min.title: Stale port minutes
ports_stale_min.description: Listeners older than this are marked stale?.

ports_kill.title: Allow STOP
ports_kill.description: Show a two-step STOP button for listeners started by this session's agents.
